comment: Gzip bytes a first visit downloads before the app runs (scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs). Measured 2026-11-13 with `npx vite build` at c157793e3: initial JS 719,611 (one entry chunk), initial CSS 18,996; the limits are about 3% above. CI (after its build) and the push gate fail a build over these; they catch sudden growth, they are not a target. Raise them only on purpose, in the commit that needs it. Raised 2026-11-18 for the memory diagnostics (#612): CI read 724.0 KiB at 22c136833, about 2 KiB above a local build. Raised 2026-11-18 for the native zoom shortcuts (#618): CI read 726.5 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the phone page slide without view transitions (#643): CI read 727.7 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the build tools update (Vite 7, esbuild 0.28): the same sources build an entry 4.0 KiB larger (725.4 to 729.4 KiB in local and gce builds), mostly in the CommonJS packages' wrappers. Raised 2026-11-19 for React Router 7: its router builds an entry 9.0 KiB larger (729.3 to 738.3 KiB in local builds); its production build, which its exports leave out, would save 0.5 KiB. Raised 2026-11-20 for the thread Back loop fix (#691): CI read 742.6 KiB on main after React Router 7, 0.1 KiB under the limit, and 742.7 KiB (760,524 B) on this fix's merge with main. Raised 2026-11-20 for tool markers out of text (#689): CI read 743.3 KiB on main at 18ed47ec1 and 744.2 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. What puts the markers back in an agent's text stays in the entry chunk, because the first render reads that text. Raised 2026-11-20 for the phone page slide copying only what shows (#715): CI read 745.8 KiB on this change's merge with main, 0.2 KiB over; the slide runs on the first tap, so its copy stays in the entry chunk. Raised 2026-11-20 for the crash-safe voice recording journal (#714): CI read 747.3 KiB with the journal's roughly 1 KiB in the entry chunk so recovery and cleanup do not depend on a separate download. Raised 2026-11-21 for the startup phase timings in the diagnostics export (#722): CI read 748.3 KiB on main at ce0dcad11, 0.7 KiB over, so every build failed. Raised 2026-11-21 for Needs you first (#733): CI read 749.5 KiB on main at b5571656b, at the limit, and the Safari fallback's anchor choice (cards that kept their order and section) adds about 0.1 KiB to the entry chunk in local builds (745.8 to 745.9 KiB), because the stored section folds are read at sign-out cleanup. Raised 2026-11-21 for the voice recording that follows navigation (#703): CI read 750.3 KiB on main at aabc4e009 and 751.1 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. The shell holds the account's one recording (to see it and end it with the account) and the Discard count its reload warning reads, so those stay in the entry chunk; the capture code loads with the composer. Raised 2026-11-21 for matrix-js-sdk 45.1: on its merge with main 1ca370936 a local build's entry is 774.0 KiB (792,614 B) against main's 747.0 KiB (764,972 B), 27,642 B more, and the limit is main's plus that (770,000 B since #703, so 797,700 B), which leaves the room main has under its own. CI then read 779.1 KiB on this change's merge with main at 33797681f, 0.1 KiB over that limit (main grew since 1ca370936), so the limit is CI's reading plus the 0.9 KiB main keeps under its own: 798,700 B. The SDK now matches push rule and invite filter globs with re2js (252 KiB of source in the entry), which its push processor calls synchronously from the client's start, so it cannot load later without a patch; oidc-client-ts (66 KiB of source) left the entry, and the SDK's own code is 87 KiB of source smaller. Raised 2026-11-22 for room membership event folding (#781): CI read 780.0 KiB on main at 710b0c8ea (at the 798,700 B limit) and 780.1 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. All membership folding code stays in the lazy Room chunk; only its 24 English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json enter the entry chunk because English resources ship statically. Raised 2026-11-22 for phone interactive edge swipes (#784): CI read 786.3 KiB initial JS and 19.3 KiB initial CSS on its merge with main (over the 781.0 KiB / 19.1 KiB limits); the phone gesture coordinator, page-slide preview/handoff, and drawer swipe hooks run on the first touch in the initial phone shell, so they stay in the entry chunk. Raised 2026-11-22 for mid-turn mode on voice messages and uploads (#788): CI read 787.8 KiB initial JS on its merge with main (0.5 KiB over the 787.3 KiB limit) because Home's ask composer now loads RoomInput in the entry chunk alongside the voice/upload mid-turn mode wiring. Raised 2026-11-23 for invite directory sheet (#780): InviteUserPrompt is lazy-loaded from all call sites and moderatorInvite helpers are tree-shaken out of the entry chunk, leaving only the 19 net English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json. Raised 2026-11-23 for the Electron desktop shell seam (#750): the shell hooks (nativeShell, desktopMediaAuth, desktopHistoryButtons, desktopShellLifecycle) and --app-inset-top CSS stay in the entry so they run before the first render and media request; on its merge with main (#780) a local build reads 786.3 KiB (805,163 B) JS and 19.3 KiB (19,814 B) CSS, so limits are raised on top of main's 810,000 B JS / 20,000 B CSS by the desktop seam's +3,300 B JS / +400 B CSS delta to 813,300 B JS and 20,400 B CSS to cover these plus CI's overhead over local builds. Raised 2026-11-23 for React 19.3.1 (and html-react-parser 5.2.3 / html-dom-parser 5.0.13): a local build reads 810.7 KiB (830,196 B) initial/entry JS gzip against origin/main f8aacc53d at 788.0 KiB (806,859 B), +23,337 B (+22.8 KiB) more (initial CSS unchanged at 19.3 KiB / 19,814 B), driven by react-dom 19.3.1 (+79,386 B minified source in the entry), react 19.3.1 (+1,251 B), html-dom-parser 5.0.13 (+1,182 B) and html-react-parser 5.2.3 (+814 B), partly offset by react-property (-1,182 B) and scheduler 0.28.0 (-301 B); JS limits are raised by +23,400 B to 836,700 B to preserve main's headroom. Raised 2026-11-23 for i18next 27.2.6 and react-i18next 18.0.3 (with html-parse-stringify 4.0.1 and unused immer removed): a local build reads 814.9 KiB (834,410 B) initial/entry JS gzip against origin/main 6c09ea9f1 at 810.7 KiB (830,196 B), +4,214 B (+4.1 KiB) more (initial CSS unchanged at 19.3 KiB / 19,814 B), driven by i18next 27 and react-i18next 18 in the entry (+8,528 B raw JS); JS limits are raised by +4,300 B to 841,000 B to preserve main's headroom. Raised 2026-11-24 for Vite 8.3.8 (Rolldown + Oxc minifier, cssMinify esbuild), @vitejs/plugin-react 6.3.0, and html-react-parser 6.1.6 / html-dom-parser 8.0.1 / domhandler 6.0.1: with the $initial codeSplitting group in vite.config.js, a local build reads 823.7 KiB (843,500 B) initial JS gzip (666.7 KiB brotli, smaller than Vite 7's 669.3 KiB) and 19.4 KiB (19,910 B) initial CSS gzip against origin/main's 834,410 B JS / 19,814 B CSS (+9,090 B JS gzip, +96 B CSS gzip); JS limits are raised by +9,100 B to 850,100 B to preserve main's headroom. Raised 2026-11-24 for Help & guides menu and contextual resolve tip (#851): HelpMenu is lazy-loaded via lazyPart, leaving only the static English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json and account-state atoms in the entry chunk; CI read 830.0 KiB on main and 830.4 KiB on merge with #851 (0.2 KiB over the 850,100 B limit), so JS limits are raised by +1,000 B to 851,100 B. Raised 2026-11-24 for cross-room thread forks (#856): all fork UI and loading code stays in the lazy Room/thread chunks, leaving only the 10 static English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json and forkRoom/forkThread/forkAt URL query parsing in nativeUniversalLinks/conversationView in the initial chunk (+0.4 KiB gzip over pre-#851 main); JS limits are raised on top of #851 by +1,000 B to 852,100 B. Raised 2026-11-24 for wave 5 dependency bumps (#860, mostly matrix-js-sdk 45.2.0 and livekit-client 2.25.0): CI read 830.9 KiB initial JS gzip on #860 (run 45452853937) against pre-#851 main's 830.0 KiB (run 45443385043), +0.9 KiB more; initialJsGzipBytes is raised by +1,700 B on top of main's 852,100 B to 853,800 B (833.8 KiB) for the +0.9 KiB delta plus ~0.8 KiB margin (leaving entryJsGzipBytes and initialCssGzipBytes unchanged). Raised 2026-11-24 for workflow run cards and the graph panel (#840): CI read 830.0 KiB on main at 47eb6277f and 830.9 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.7 KiB over. The graph panel is a lazy chunk; the growth is mostly the 88 net English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json (about 3.5 KB raw), which ship statically. JS limits are raised by +1,100 B on top of main's to 854,900 B initial and 853,200 B entry. Raised 2026-11-24 in #914: main at ba3866a97 (CI run 45545403873) already read 835.2 KiB initial JS gzip (0.3 KiB over the 854,900 B limit) after #909/#910/#912; #914 itself reduces initial JS gzip by 0.2 KiB to 835.0 KiB (CI run 45547875771). Raising initialJsGzipBytes by +1,100 B to 856,000 B (835.9 KiB) restores ~0.9 KiB headroom. Raised 2026-11-24 for Mac Computer Access (#913): all desktop-access JS/CSS modules are lazy-loaded, leaving only the 122 static English i18n keys in locales/additions/en.json in the initial chunk; CI read 836.9 KiB (856,986 B), so initialJsGzipBytes is raised from 856,000 B to 858,000 B (leaving entryJsGzipBytes and initialCssGzipBytes unchanged). Raised 2026-11-25 for encrypted thread summary pointer persistence (#976): CI read 837.8 KiB on main after #972 (run 45769933080, 0.1 KiB under the 858,000 B limit) and 838.3 KiB on #976's merge with main (run 45772828026, +0.5 KiB gzip for pointer persistence and detached decryption in the initial event-store chunk); initialJsGzipBytes is raised from 858,000 B to 860,000 B (839.8 KiB, leaving entryJsGzipBytes and initialCssGzipBytes unchanged). Raised 2026-11-26 for dictation transient-outage recovery (#986): main at 547ef4f39 (CI run 45876404883) already read 839.8 KiB initial JS gzip right at the 860,000 B limit, and #986 (CI run 45881761192) added +0.1 KiB raw from the static English key composer.dictation.temporarilyUnavailable in locales/additions/en.json; initialJsGzipBytes is raised from 860,000 B to 861,000 B (leaving entryJsGzipBytes and initialCssGzipBytes unchanged). Raised 2026-11-26 for batched live IDB writes and bounded sync catch-up fan-out (#994): CI read 840.9 KiB initial JS gzip on merge with main f0992fee5 (run 45929270134, 0.1 KiB over the 861,000 B limit; local build reads 838.3 KiB) because the event-store sync engine and liveWriteQueue stay in the initial chunk; initialJsGzipBytes is raised from 861,000 B to 863,000 B (842.8 KiB, leaving entryJsGzipBytes and initialCssGzipBytes unchanged). Raised 2026-11-28 for removing the dictation cap (#1028): Linux main CI read 842.8 KiB initial JS gzip at f00389f53 (#1024, run 46166888542), 842.7 KiB at d77645b39 (#1026, run 46178225639, 0.1 KiB under the 863,000 B limit), and 842.9 KiB at 768b4fe4d (#1028, run 46185012184, 0.1 KiB over the 842.8 KiB limit; entry JS 1.5 KiB and initial CSS 19.7 KiB passed); source maps show the dictation runtime stays lazy, with captureJournal.ts (initial since #714) and time.ts (#1028) in the initial chunk (+0.4 KiB raw, +0.2 KiB gzip since #1026; macOS m5 reads 840.7 KiB with --sourcemap); initialJsGzipBytes is raised by +2,000 B to 865,000 B, restoring ~1.8 KiB of CI headroom.
